h1: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Howrah

h1Text: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Howrah

items.pText: Howrah sits across the Hooghly from Kolkata, one of the oldest industrial towns in Bengal, with dense lanes, old buildings and very little open ground. Play space here is often a small courtyard, a school terrace or the patch of land in front of a neighbourhood club. FunPlay Systems makes playground equipment that fits these spaces at our factory in Vasai, about 1,640 km away, and sends it to West Bengal by road.

In a small space, the safe play area around each piece decides what fits, more than the size of the piece itself. A tall station may need a wide clear zone, while a short slide with a climber needs much less. We start from the exact measurements of your space, mark doors, pillars and drains, and suggest pieces that still leave children room to move. Howrah's humid summers and heavy monsoon also call for materials that will not rust.

props.h2Text: How would you like to start?
props.pText: Turn your playground dreams to reality

richText.heading: Fitting play into a small courtyard or club ground

c: Combine activities on one frame instead of placing several separate pieces. A small play station with a slide, a climber and a deck covers what three individual items would, in less ground. Spring riders fit into corners where nothing else will go. Avoid merry-go-rounds and full swing sets in tight spaces, since they need clear ground on every side. Lay rubber flooring right up to the walls, so the whole courtyard is cushioned underfoot.

facts.label: Distance
facts.value: About 1,640 km from our Vasai factory (straight line)

facts.label: Delivery and installation
facts.value: By road from Vasai; installed by our team or a local dealer

items.q: What play equipment fits a very small courtyard?
items.a: A small play station that combines a slide and a climber on one frame, plus a spring rider or two. Send us exact measurements and we will check that every safe play area fits.

items.q: Can neighbourhood clubs in Howrah order from you?
items.a: Yes. Clubs, schools, societies and municipal bodies can all order directly. We deliver from Vasai by road and install with our own team or a dealer in eastern India.

items.q: Can playground equipment go on a school terrace?
items.a: Often, yes. On a concrete terrace we usually choose self-standing installation so the slab is not drilled, with rubber flooring on top. Have your engineer check the railing and the load first.
